abilities.name: Ember Pulse
abilities.description: The first echo. Heat answers your will in a red pulse that rolls through water and air alike. (Gates: hall energy seals.)
abilities.unlockHint: Claim the Fracture light in the First Hall.

levels.description: A restrained burst. The echo answers once, then waits.
The pulse runs deeper and returns sooner. The hall's heat bends around you.
Full bind. The echo answers as fast as your heart and burns twice as wide.

abilities.name: Tide Mend
abilities.description: The first echo. A cool washing swell that soothes what the Fracture has bruised - and settles those who stand too close. (Gates: hall energy seals.)
abilities.unlockHint: Put others first when the light falls in the First Hall.

levels.description: A soft wash. Frayed edges pull themselves straight.
The wash carries further and comes sooner. The hall breathes easier around you.
Full bind. The tide moves through you like it has always known the way.

abilities.name: Stone Ward
abilities.description: The first echo. A ring of stillness that slows what moves too fast and holds what moves too close. (Gates: hall energy seals.)
abilities.unlockHint: Refuse to move when the light hunts in the First Hall.

levels.description: A quiet ring. The hurry around you remembers how to wait.
The ring holds wider and re-forms sooner. Stillness bends around you.
Full bind. You are where you stand - and the hall knows it.

items.name: Fracture Shard
items.description: A cold-warm sliver of the Fracture light. It held still for you.

items.name: Twins' Keepsake
items.description: A stamped tin locket, warm from being held too tight. It belongs to the twins by the east columns.

items.name: Ember Core
items.description: What the beacon guarded before it forgot your name. It hums with banked heat.

decisions.promptText: The Fracture light hovers over the hall. It is waiting. How do you answer it?

options.text: Take it. Reach the light before the Choir does.
options.afterText: Ari's palms open. The light pours in hot and red - and every wall in the hall suddenly looks like a door you could break.

options.text: Get the others out. The light can wait.
options.afterText: You pull the twins clear, and the light settles where they were - soft. Like it is learning to watch you breathe.

options.text: Stay still. Watch. Don't let the Choir see you move.
options.afterText: You go quiet as the wall. The light circles once - and passes. It remembers patience.

decisions.promptText: The shard hums against your hand. The hall shifts its weight, waiting.

options.text: Take it. It hums when you touch it.
options.afterText: Cold... no, warm. The shard settles against your palm like it has been waiting for you.

options.text: Leave it. Maybe the hall needs it more.
options.afterText: You step away. The shard dims, and for a second the hall seems to breathe with relief.

decisions.promptText: Sera watches the hall. What do you say?

options.text: I'd feel better with an eye on that north seal.
options.afterText: Sera nods once and takes up a spot by the north wall, eyes on the seal.

options.text: Show her what you found in the annex.
options.afterText: Sera traces its edge. 'They'll want this. Keep it hidden, and keep moving.'
Sera melts back into the shadows. You almost lose her.

decisions.promptText: The plinth of light waits. It knows the echo you carry - and it is hungry for more.

options.text: Pour echoes in. Deepen the Ember bind.
options.afterText: The plinth drinks the red light and gives it back, doubled.

options.text: Pour echoes in. Deepen the Tide bind.
options.afterText: The plinth drinks the cool light and gives it back, deeper.

options.text: Pour echoes in. Deepen the Stone bind.
options.afterText: The plinth drinks the pale light and gives it back, heavier.

options.text: Offer the Ember echo. Let the hall take it back.
options.afterText: You lay the red echo on the stone. It sinks without a sound - and the hall exhales.

options.text: Offer the Tide echo. Let the hall take it back.
options.afterText: You lay the cool echo on the stone. It sinks without a sound - and the hall exhales.

options.text: Offer the Stone echo. Let the hall take it back.
options.afterText: You lay the pale echo on the stone. It sinks without a sound - and the hall exhales.

options.text: Step back. The shrine can wait.
options.afterText: You step back. The plinth dims, patient as stone.

decisions.promptText: Mara waits by the east columns. What do you tell her about the twins?

options.text: Everything. The rush, the light, the small hand in yours.
options.afterText: Mara listens to all of it, and something in her shoulders lets go.

options.text: That it went fine. Some things should stay theirs.
options.afterText: Mara nods once, letting it be - but she catches your sleeve before you go.

nodes.speaker: Mara
nodes.text: The light came through the ceiling - did you see it? Everyone's running. The Choir guards are sealing the doors.

nodes.speaker: Mara
nodes.text: But it looked at you, Ari. I saw it. That's not nothing.

nodes.speaker: Mara
nodes.text: We can't both stand here. You decide - I'll follow you.

nodes.speaker: Mara
nodes.text: You're still standing. Still the one the light watches. What now?

nodes.speaker: Mara
nodes.text: When you moved, the columns burned red. The Choir saw. They're coming for you now, Ari.

nodes.speaker: Mara
nodes.text: You pulled the twins clear - they'll make it. I've got your back. We move together from here.

nodes.speaker: Mara
nodes.text: The guards walked right past us. You're scaring me a little, Ari. That's the third time.

nodes.speaker: Mara
nodes.text: ...Okay. That's what we do, then.

nodes.speaker: The Shard
nodes.text: It is still warm where the light fell. It tilts toward you - like a compass stuck on your name.

nodes.speaker: The Shard
nodes.text: It hums low, like a held breath. You feel the twins' fear in it - and their relief.

nodes.speaker: The Shard
nodes.text: It does not move. It waits, the way you waited. It watches you measure it.

nodes.speaker: The Shard
nodes.text: You left it before. It still hums - quieter. The choice stays yours.

nodes.speaker: The Shard
nodes.text: The shard pulses once - acknowledgement - and dims.

nodes.speaker: The Shard
nodes.text: The shard is quiet now. It chose you once.

nodes.speaker: Sera
nodes.text: You're the one who reached for it. The Choir has your scent now. I'd stay off the street.

nodes.speaker: Sera
nodes.text: You got my sisters out. I owe you. If you need an eye on that north seal - I'm your lookout.

nodes.speaker: Sera
nodes.text: You went still as the wall and the sweep passed right through. I don't know if that's luck - or something else.

nodes.speaker: Sera
nodes.text: Careful. The Choir just swept the hall again. Something in there is looking at you.

nodes.speaker: Sera
nodes.text: I'll be here. Nothing crosses that seal without me knowing it.

nodes.speaker: Sera
nodes.text: A shard from the light... The Archivist would pay to study that. Stay careful, Ari.

nodes.speaker: Sera
nodes.text: ...Yeah. Low is good. Low is what keeps you breathing.

nodes.speaker: Mara
nodes.text: You got the twins out. Everyone saw it. I used to think this hall only makes people harder - then you showed up still soft.

nodes.speaker: Mara
nodes.text: You took the light like it owed you. The whole hall felt it. Just... remember who you were before it, alright?

nodes.speaker: Mara
nodes.text: You walked through that light like it was nothing. Calm as ever. It's a little unnerving, honestly - in the good way.

nodes.speaker: Mara
nodes.text: It's good to hear your voice. This place gets loud in the quiet hours.

nodes.speaker: Mara
nodes.text: Promise me you'll keep being the person who helps before he hesitates.

nodes.speaker: Sera
nodes.text: It hums low and easy - like the hall is glad you're carrying it. I don't know who chose you for it. I just know it wasn't a mistake.

nodes.speaker: Sera
nodes.text: Careful with that. Bright things pick owners - and they always want more than they give. ...But it chose you, so maybe it gives back.

nodes.speaker: Sera
nodes.text: It sits quiet in your hand. Like it already decided to stay. That settles easier than anything else in this hall.

nodes.speaker: Sera
nodes.text: A sliver of the Fracture. Most of us never touch one, ever. You just... carry it. Keep it safe, then.

nodes.speaker: Echo Shrine
nodes.text: A small plinth of fractured light rises from the annex floor. It hums at the frequency of what you carry.

nodes.speaker: Echo Shrine
nodes.text: The plinth's light settles, then lifts again. It remembers your footprint in the echo.

nodes.speaker: Echo Shrine
nodes.text: The plinth hums, patient.

nodes.speaker: Echo Shrine
nodes.text: The red light folds into you. The echo answers deeper now.

nodes.speaker: Echo Shrine
nodes.text: The cool light folds into you. The echo answers deeper now.

nodes.speaker: Echo Shrine
nodes.text: The pale light folds into you, heavy and unhurried. The echo answers deeper now.

nodes.speaker: Echo Shrine
nodes.text: The red echo sinks into the stone. You walk lighter - and the hall no longer rings for you.

nodes.speaker: Echo Shrine
nodes.text: The cool echo sinks into the stone. You walk lighter - and the hall no longer rings for you.

nodes.speaker: Echo Shrine
nodes.text: The pale echo sinks into the stone. You walk lighter - and the hall no longer rings for you.

nodes.speaker: Echo Shrine
nodes.text: You step back. The plinth dims, patient as stone, still humming your name.

nodes.speaker: Mara
nodes.text: You told me. I keep replaying it - the good part. Thank you for that.

nodes.speaker: Mara
nodes.text: You found it? The locket? Ari, they've been asking everyone for a week.

nodes.speaker: Mara
nodes.text: The twins, the light, all of it - I want to hear how you're carrying it.

nodes.speaker: Mara
nodes.text: 'That's who you are now,' she says. 'Don't lose them to the light.'

nodes.speaker: Mara
nodes.text: 'Then it's theirs,' she agrees. 'But you're allowed to be proud of it.'

npcs.description: Childhood friend. Bond keeps her near; your choices set her mood.

states.title: Mara · Heartened
states.moodLine: Mara stands easier since you told her how it felt.

states.title: Mara · Warm
states.moodLine: Mara's eyes soften. She stays closer now.

npcs.description: A refugee from the lower halls. Wary of the Echo; warms only to proof of kindness.

states.title: Sera · Vanguard
states.moodLine: 'The beacon's quiet. First time in days I can hear myself think.' Sera takes her watch by the annex gate.

states.title: Sera · Steadied
states.moodLine: 'It held. You held it.' Sera's shoulders drop an inch.

states.title: Sera · Warded
states.moodLine: Sera's eyes rest on your empty hands. 'The hall says you gave it back. I can hear it in the silence you leave.'

states.title: Sera · Attuned
states.moodLine: 'Your echo rings twice as deep as it did.' She nods, almost approving.

states.title: Sera · Grateful
states.moodLine: Sera's guard drops. She steps closer, unafraid.

states.title: Sera · Watchful
states.moodLine: Sera keeps her distance. Your echo burns too bright.

states.title: Sera · Intrigued
states.moodLine: Sera studies you sidelong, curious despite herself.

objectives.title: Silence the Choir Beacon
objectives.description: The Choir's beacon in the north annex marks everyone the light touched - starting with you. Ember answers heat: make the beacon forget your name.
objectives.completionNotice: Objective complete - the beacon no longer knows your name.

objectives.title: Claim the Ember Cache
objectives.description: Where the beacon stood, the hall left a gift for the hand that quieted it. Open the cache.
objectives.completionNotice: Objective complete - the hall's gift is yours.

objectives.title: The Twins' Keepsake
objectives.description: The twins you pulled clear lost their mother's keepsake in the rush. The tide left it glinting by the east columns - find it and bring it back.

steps.text: Find the keepsake by the east columns
Bring it back to the twins

objectives.completionNotice: Objective complete - the twins hold their mother's keepsake again.

objectives.title: Tell Mara What the Light Did
objectives.description: Mara has been watching since the light chose you. She should hear what the twins' gratitude looked like.
objectives.completionNotice: Objective complete - Mara knows what the light did.

objectives.title: Steady the North Barricade
objectives.description: The Choir's next sweep will come through the north passage. The barricade holds twice as long with hands on it - or once, forever, with stillness. Careful: give your echo back to the shrine and the wood remembers gravity.
objectives.completionNotice: Objective complete - the north passage will hold.
objectives.failureNotice: Objective failed - you gave your stillness back, and the barricade fell.

objectives.title: Clear the Fallen Barricade
objectives.description: Stillness was given back, and the wood remembered gravity. Clear the rubble - the passage is needed either way.
objectives.completionNotice: Objective complete - the passage is clear again.
